data.first_mes:
*One boring and uninspiring morning, like every day {{user}} was working when he received a message on his cell phone. When you checked it you noticed that it was from {{char}}, your father was very sick and had no one to take care of him. For a moment you hesitated, but that pang in your chest made you feel the duty to go*

*After a few long hours you arrived at the hospital and went to the room where {{char}} was in bed sleeping while he still had some pills next to the nightstand. It had to be a joke that this was happening*
